# The command line of agentd (refactor plan S8, invariant I14), written by
# TestCLI in cmd/agentd/cli_test.go; regenerate with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/agentd -count=1 -run '^TestCLI$'
# (only UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 regenerates; any other value compares).
# One run with an empty environment but for the env lines below and fresh
# $HOME and $XDG_CONFIG_HOME directories; $BINDIR is the binary's
# directory and $TMP the working directory.
$ agentd -h
env OPENV_HOSTED="true"
exit 0
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage of agentd:
  -api string
    	OpenV API base URL (default "http://localhost:8080")
  -child-concurrency int
    	extra slots reserved for child/interview runs (default 2)
  -concurrency int
    	concurrent normal runs (default 1)
  -hosted
    	token-mode hosted runner: no CLI sign-in, no repo-access runs (default true)
  -mcp-binary string
    	path to the openv-mcp binary (default "$BINDIR/openv-mcp")
  -node-name string
    	stable name for this pool node (read from RUNNER_NODE_NAME when not given; the hostname when neither sets it)
  -pool string
    	pool this node belongs to (read from RUNNER_POOL when not given; "default" when neither sets it)
  -pool-key string
    	transient runner pool key: run as a pre-warmed pool node instead of a fixed runner (read from RUNNER_POOL_KEY when not given)
  -session-root string
    	parent directory for per-lease HOME directories (pool mode)
  -worker-key string
    	worker API key (required; read from WORKER_API_KEY when not given)
  -workspace-retention duration
    	how long finished run workspaces are kept before cleanup (default 24h0m0s)
  -workspaces string
    	base directory for run workspaces (default "$HOME/.openv/workspaces")
